results.title: A tool for life science researchers for multiple hypothesis ...
results.content: Our tool available at www.multipletesting.com allows choosing from the most frequently used multiple-testing correction methods, including the Bonferroni, the Holm (step-down), the Hochberg (step-up) adjustments, calculation of False Discovery Rates (FDR), and q-values. The elevated number of simultaneous statistical tests increases the danger that the number of irrelevant false positives exceeds the number of true discoveries; therefore, multiple-testing correction methods are required. Methods involving the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control and Storey’s q work solely off the p values and assume that all statistical tests have the same power to detect discoveries.
